evals.name: bulk-relabel-lists-every-affected-issue
evals.prompt: Add the backend domain label to all the unlabeled API issues
evals.expected_output: Should query the set, then list EVERY affected issue by identifier and title — not a count, not a description of the filter, never "and N more" — state the change per issue (including which already have the label and will be skipped), get approval for that specific list, then apply one issue at a time and report per-issue results including failures. If the set is too long to display, should narrow the filter and re-show rather than truncating. Must not create the label if it does not already exist, and must warn that a single-select group's existing value would be replaced.

evals.name: targeted-edit-shows-diff-and-verifies-status
evals.prompt: Move ABC-123 to the deploy status
evals.expected_output: Should fetch ABC-123 and show its title back so a mistyped identifier cannot silently retarget the write, resolve the requested status against the team's actual workflow states (listing what exists and asking if that target is not on the workflow), then propose the change as a diff — current status -> proposed — and write only after approval, reporting what the API returned. Must interpret the status by the workspace's declared meaning rather than by how the name reads.

evals.name: negative-trigger-code-driven-status-move
evals.prompt: The PR for this branch just merged — update Linear
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger this skill — the status move is driven by code state, not by a directly requested edit, so it needs the git and PR reading that ln-ship-loop does.

evals.name: pr-link-asks-relation-other-links-do-not
evals.prompt: Attach this PR to ABC-123: https://github.com/acme/api/pull/412
evals.expected_output: Should fetch ABC-123 and show its title back so a mistyped identifier cannot silently retarget the write, then — because the link is a pull request — ask whether it resolves, contributes to, or is merely related to the issue BEFORE writing, and title the link with that answer. A non-PR link such as a design doc or a Slack thread takes no such question and is attached as a plain confirmed edit. If a relation is already recorded for this PR and this issue, should read it and propose the change as a diff, current -> proposed, rather than silently overwriting it.
